user.description: $ Building ML pipelines, computer vision systems, and production-ready AI applications that work at scale.

about.heading: Engineering intelligence into everything I build.
paragraphs: I'm a final-year Data Science student at Ramaiah University, Bengaluru. I work at the intersection of machine learning, backend engineering, and data — building systems that go from raw data to production-ready insights.

My internship at the Centre for National Security Studies involved real computer vision work: curating massive datasets, implementing transfer learning pipelines, and benchmarking models for deployment. On the side I've built a Bundesliga prediction engine and a full RAG system on AWS Bedrock.
I'm comfortable across the full stack — from FastAPI and Supabase on the backend to React on the frontend — but ML and data pipelines are where I'm most at home.

contact.message: Open to full-time roles, internships, and interesting collaborations in data science, ML engineering, and backend development. Based in Bengaluru — remote-capable.

projects.name: SPIELTAG — BUNDESLIGA PREDICTOR
projects.description: Stacking ensemble ML architecture with Optuna hyperparameter tuning. Aggregated 10 seasons of xG JSON, CSV, and REST API data into a unified training set. Meta-model: Multinomial Logistic Regression (Log Loss: 0.9702). Live React dashboard powered by Supabase real-time backend.

projects.name: RAG APPLICATION
projects.description: Production-style Retrieval-Augmented Generation system using FastAPI. Sentence-transformer embeddings with top-K context selection for cost-aware inference. Integrated AWS Bedrock (Titan LLM) with secure IAM roles and async inference. Full-stack monorepo — backend on Render, frontend on Vercel.

bullets: Engineered a 100K+ image dataset for human detection by programmatically curating and processing the COCO dataset.
Applied bounding box annotations and systematic augmentations, improving model accuracy by over 20%.
Evaluated and benchmarked 3+ deep learning models on a 20K image sample to identify the optimal deployment architecture.
Implemented MobileNetV2 transfer learning (ImageNet), freezing base layers and customising the classifier — achieving 92%+ accuracy.
Built interactive dashboards using Python and Power BI to deliver clear, actionable project metrics.
Coursework spanning ML, deep learning, statistical modelling, time series analysis, and data engineering.
Built and shipped production-ready ML and fullstack projects as part of coursework and independent study.
